logline: Gerald and Clarissa arrive at the cottage with an armed constable accusing Alexander of grand theft, culminating in a devastating planted discovery that threatens to tear the newlyweds apart.

moments.description: Gerald steps down from his carriage into the mud in an opulent burgundy coat, radiating smug self-satisfaction outside the rustic cottage.
Gerald aggressively accuses Alexander of stealing his gold pocket watch, leaving Juliana gasping in utter disbelief.
moments.key_dialogue: Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!

moments.description: Gerald mocks Juliana for marrying a beggar, prompting Alexander to step forward with a murderous and menacing gaze.
The constable violently ransacks the cottage while a desperate Juliana drops to her knees to save her mother's medicines.
moments.key_dialogue: Stop! Those are my mother's medicines!

moments.description: Juliana furiously confronts Gerald, realizing he planted the entire accusation out of jealousy.
moments.key_dialogue: You planted this accusation because you cannot bear that I am happy without you!

moments.description: The constable pulls Gerald's stolen pocket watch from the pocket of Alexander's coat, leaving Juliana in shattered disbelief as Gerald triumphs.
